versions.changelog:
yoooclaw-expense-tracker-en 1.0.0

- Initial release: Extracts and categorizes personal consumption transactions from mobile notifications, summarizing by category and time.
- Supports various sources (WeChat, SMS, Alipay, banks, shopping apps, etc.) with automatic category recognition and duplicate removal.
- Allows filtering by category and customizable time ranges (today, this week, last month, custom date ranges).
- Handles positive payments as well as refunds (negative values) and separates personal transfers from other spending.
- User can set summary preferences for focused analysis (e.g., only dining, only large purchases).
- Skips non-relevant notifications (marketing, bill reminders, financial product updates). Prompts user for a data path if notification storage is not found.
